meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

copy.tagline: 将AI Runway快速部署到Azure Kubernetes集群
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在Azure上搭建AI推理环境
copy.tagline_en: Deploy AI Runway onto an AKS cluster in minutes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up AI inference on Azure

howto.what: 它会按 6 个步骤带你走完 AKS 上的 AI Runway 搭建：检查集群与 GPU、安装控制器、评估 GPU 兼容性、选装推理框架（KAITO、Dynamo、KubeRay）、部署第一个模型、最后总结。每步先报状态（✓ 正常 / ✗ 缺失），安装或部署前会先征求你同意。
howto.when: 当你说「setup AI Runway」「install AI Runway」「deploy model to AKS」等，或想在已有的 AKS 集群上跑模型推理时触发。如果还没有集群，它会先交给 azure-kubernetes 技能去创建。

say.text: 帮我在这个 AKS 集群上安装 AI Runway
say.note: 它会先检查集群和 GPU 状态

say.text: 从第 3 步开始，评估我的 GPU 能跑什么模型
say.note: 跳过前两步，直接从 GPU 评估继续

say.text: 把我的模型部署到 AKS，并确认状态为 Ready
say.note: 走完选推理框架和首次部署两步

howto.what_en: It walks you through six steps: verify the AKS cluster and GPU, install the AI Runway controller, assess GPU compatibility, pick an inference provider, deploy a first model, and recap. Status is reported and it asks before installing.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "setup AI Runway", "install AI Runway", or "deploy model to AKS", or when you want model inference on an existing AKS cluster. Without a cluster, it hands off to azure-kubernetes.

say_en.note: Checks cluster and GPU state first

say_en.text: Start at step 3 and assess what my GPU can run
say_en.note: Skips ahead to the GPU assessment

say_en.text: Deploy my model to AKS and confirm it's Ready
say_en.note: Covers provider setup and first deployment
